outline: 本課程之主旨在於加強學生對物化處理程序之深入了解，以作為進一步對水質管理應用之基礎。課程內容包括化學反應動力學、高等氧化還原程序、薄膜處理、離子交換、吸附處理及高級消毒處理程序等之應用。
schedule:
Week	Contents
1	Introduction
2-3	Membrane Filtration
4-5	Reverse Osmosis
6	Reactor analysis
7	Midterm #1
8	Reactor analysis
9-10	Separation Processes and Mass Transfer
11-12	Chemical Oxidation and Reduction
13	Midterm #2
14-15	Adsorption
16-17	Disinfection Byproducts
18	Final Examination
assessment:
Mid term twice	         30 %
Homework	                  10 %
PowerPoint presentation	30 %
Final examination	         30 %
